rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs recognized by the AMA Council on Medical Education, AOA or ACCME; AMA or AOA "Category I" or equivalent; 1 clock hour = 1 hour; board-approved postgraduate training (3 months = 30 hours)
rules.audit_note: Signed statement on the renewal application; random biennial audit; keep evidence through the biennium (Med 13.05-13.06). The Board runs CME audits through CE Broker (basic account free, optional).

topics.who: Physicians holding a U.S. DEA number at renewal: course on prescribing opioids and other controlled substances, part of the 30 hours (Med 13.02(1x))

rules.notes: One board (Medical Examining Board, DSPS) licenses MDs and DOs; renewal by Oct 31 of odd years, fee $120. Opioid/controlled-substance 2 hours are part of the 30 (Med 13.02(1x)); separate from the DEA 8-hour MATE training.
rules.legal_basis: Wis. Admin. Code ch. Med 13 (Med 13.02-13.06); Wis. Stat. s. 448.13
rules.alternatives: Board-approved postgraduate training: 3 consecutive months count as the full 30 hours. Waiver possible for prolonged illness/disability.
